messages:
anya: Heads-up: nightly eval flagged a big drop for rw-v3-7b with fp8 quant profile on regression_suite_v4 — pass_rate down ~8.7% vs baseline. Report: https://internal.eval/reports/1748604500
mike: ugh, is this INT8 or FP8 run? which profile?
anya: FP8 (profile fp8_dynamic_v2). INT8 baseline (int8_calib_v1) looks fine in the same run.
eval-bot: ALERT: metric 'answer_quality@regression_suite_v4' dropped 8.7% (p<0.01). See /alerts/1748604500.
zara: can you paste top failing prompts or examples? is it reasoning, safety, or hallucination cases?
anya: top failures: 1) multi-step math Q where it drops correctness, 2) long-context summarization truncation/ hallucination, 3) code-generation snippets with wrong API calls. I attached small samples in the report. Reproducer:
```
./run_eval --model rw-v3-7b --profile fp8_dynamic_v2 --prompts regression_suite_v4 --seed 42 --out out.json
```
mike: can you also attach the calibration log? maybe scale/clipping went wrong during conversion -> exponent saturation or mantissa rounding issues
anya: uploaded quant_profiles/1748604500/calibration.log — quick skim: layers 13-15 show elevated int_overflow_counts and max_exponent values hitting upper clip.
luis: that smells like dynamic range / exponent bias problem in the fp8 scheme. try increasing exponent range or switch those layers to per-channel scaling. Also try fp8_mantissa_fix branch on the compiler.
zara: also check calibration corpus — if you used short prompts only, calibration underestimates activations for long-context prompts. calibration corpus mismatch -> distribution shift.
anya: ugh that was the issue: calib used 'calib_snippets_small' by mistake (short examples). I'll rerun with 'calib_mixed_length_v2' and larger sample size.
mike: for quick mitigation we can route the reg-suite traffic to int8_calib_v1 until we confirm FP8 stability :eyes:
anya: agreed, filing a canary: routing policy to fallback to int8 for routes matching /evals/regression_suite_v4.
eval-bot: DEPLOY-TICKET created: #DEPLOY-9123 by anya -> route canary + rollback profile for reg-suite
zara: when you rerun, also dump per-layer scale histograms and exponent distributions (CSV) so we can compare baseline vs fp8 run.
anya: will post new logs in ~30m. thanks for the triage.
luis: if rerun still fails, let's try a calibration sweep: vary exponent_range=[4,6,8], per_channel=[true,false], and use mixed-length corpus. should converge.
anya: noted — running sweep now (background). I'll post results + short summary once done.
mike: nice. also add a quick eval on the small safety prompt set to ensure no regressions there.
anya: will include that.
